neighbours.label: the comma in Descartes's 'I think, therefore I am'
fire: His famous line "I think, therefore I am" opens the chapter.
Descartes wrote "I think, therefore I am" in French first.
The motto "I think, therefore I am" appears on the wall.
We read "I think, therefore I am" in the first class.
She quoted Descartes: "I think, therefore, I am" and sat down.
The phrase "I think, therefore I am" is known to most students.
For Descartes, "I think, therefore I am" was the first certain truth.
He printed "I think, therefore I am" on a shirt.
quiet: His famous line "I came and I saw" opens the chapter.
Descartes wrote "I doubt and I wonder" in French first.
The motto "I think it is good" appears on the wall.
We read "I think of you" in the first class.
She quoted Descartes: "I think of nothing" and sat down.
The phrase "I think so" is known to most students.
For Descartes, "I think of God" was the first certain truth.
He printed "I think you are nice" on a shirt.

notes: Other 'X, therefore' reached 0.17 in a probe; short sentences with the same line read 0.07 where longer framing read 0.86, so the frame around the quote matters.
